ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade slow → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate barrage
ourKits.winCondition: weave abilities for Gunslinger triple-shots and keep Rocket Dash up by hitting heroes
ourKits.passive: casting an ability grants attack speed and makes the next basic fire three times
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates space for him to keep shooting
ourKits.playAgainst: Rocket Dash is his only escape and comes back faster when he hits heroes, so engage right after he uses it; Ventilate is a short channel worth interrupting

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
ourKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
ourKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
ourKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
ourKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes through the target → Line Tempo wolf → Circle Rhythm for shield and speed → All-Kill! once Track is maxed
enemyKits.winCondition: hit heroes with abilities to max Track, then cast All-Kill! to drop a wolf pack on every hero she recently damaged
enemyKits.passive: Biting Melody adds magical damage on-hit; every few seconds an empowered basic applies Track and restores mana
enemyKits.playWith: teammates who engage or slow so she can dash in and land every ability for Track
enemyKits.playAgainst: All-Kill! only works once she has stacked Track, so do not trade abilities with her for free; fight after Rushing Beat charges are spent, burst through Circle Rhythm's shield, and buy magical armor if she gets ahead

enemyKits.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
enemyKits.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
enemyKits.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
enemyKits.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

enemyKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
enemyKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
enemyKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill to slow, Molotov to ignite the oil, Flame Turrets to keep shooting, then Inferno and its knockback belch.
enemyKits.winCondition: Layer oil, fire and turrets on a choke or objective and burn the team that has to stand in it.
enemyKits.passive: Badlands Critter basics stack Slick, a slow that lets his fire ignite the target.
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire and oil.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not fight in his oil and fire; flank around it. Melee basics break Flame Turrets quickly, and turrets go inactive when he moves away from them, so drag the fight off them; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Ascend to dive onto the backline, Chastise to slow and reset her basic attack, Heaven's Fury to go untargetable and strike, then Heresy for speed, attack speed and true-damage burns.
enemyKits.winCondition: Dive the backline, get the first takedown and chain free Heresy activations from Fallen Grace.
enemyKits.passive: Fallen Grace: hero takedowns drop a visage that, when touched, activates Heresy for free and cuts her basic ability cooldowns.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline that creates her dive angle and CC that holds targets for her.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not waste CC or burst during Heaven's Fury, since she is invulnerable then; hit her as she lands from Ascend. Deny the first kill so she cannot pick up the visage.

bullets: Rushing Beat, Line Tempo and Circle Rhythm set off Megacosm's max-health damage over time and Caustica's extra damage to heroes above 50% health with bonus magical armor.
Vesh put damage over time on heroes hit by abilities, Mind Rot added bonus damage from the target's current health, and Lich healed Shinbi from magical damage dealt.
Timewarp cut non-ultimate cooldowns every 8s on top of 65 ability haste, so more ability hits stacked World Breaker's magical damage boost and Track toward All-Kill!.
Casts armed Gunslinger's three-shot attack and Solaris's healing empowered hit, on a short item cooldown; the shots applied Tainted Rounds and Sky Splitter at reduced strength.
Basic attacks on heroes trimmed Vortex Grenade and Vaporize cooldowns through Ashbringer, once per ability, and shortened Rocket Dash, so casts and Gunslinger shots came back sooner.
Weald fired true-damage missiles at low-health heroes, once per hero per cooldown; Wind-Rider's attack speed after Rocket Dash could add missiles; Forage added farm gold.
Forticus shielded Crunch on hero hits, on a cooldown, and grew max health in trades; Mistmeadow Buckler blocked part of magical hits; Draconum stacked increased healing.
Forward Crunch armed Berserker's Axe's slowing hit; each cast boosted the next basic attack through Cross Crunch, building toward Re-Crunch's heal every third hero or monster hit.
Hitting heroes kept Nihil's Doom up, building power and armor through fights; Growing Threat later added damage and omnivamp; Adaptive Plating added armor matching damage taken.
